stock.description: BHCC Holding Limited operates primarily as a lead contractor, offering comprehensive building and construction services across Singapore. The company organizes its operations into two distinct divisions. The Main Contractor segment is responsible for the overall management and execution of construction projects from inception to completion. In contrast, the Subcontractor segment specializes in delivering reinforced concrete services, which encompass formwork, steel reinforcement, and concrete pouring. BHCC's extensive project portfolio covers educational institutions, residential complexes, commercial buildings, and industrial facilities, catering to both public and private sector clients. Its key customers include various Singaporean government agencies, such as those overseeing educational facilities and public housing developments, as well as other major construction contractors and property developers or owners throughout Singapore.
